novel_features.name: Newsletter compose
novel_features.description: Author a multi-section newsletter by fanning out across N chatflows in one command — perfect for an agent assembling a weekly market report.
novel_features.rationale: No single Flowise endpoint composes multi-section output; requires an orchestrator that loops through prediction calls and concatenates results with chatId provenance recorded locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs to assemble a structured multi-section document from several specialized chatflows in one shot.

novel_features.name: Predict batch fan-out
novel_features.description: Run a chatflow against a CSV or NDJSON of questions concurrently and stream back NDJSON results.
novel_features.rationale: Flowise has no batch endpoint; agents must hand-roll concurrency. We do it locally with a worker pool that preserves chatIds for replay.
novel_features.example: flowiseai-pp-cli predict batch abc123 --input listings.csv --concurrency 4 --out results.ndjson --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when fanning a single chatflow across many inputs (per-listing summaries, per-neighborhood briefs, bulk Q&A).

novel_features.name: Docstore folder ingest
novel_features.description: Walk a folder of source material and ingest every matching file into a document store in one call, then trigger vector indexing.
novel_features.rationale: Two real API endpoints (`/document-store/upsert/{id}` and `/vector/upsert/{id}`) plus a filepath walker — no single competitor wraps both with the file-walk pattern an agent actually wants.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when fresh source material arrives in a folder and an agent needs it indexed without writing glue code.

novel_features.name: Cross-prediction FTS search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every recorded prediction with filters on time window, cited document store, used tool, and chatflow.
novel_features.rationale: Flowise's chat-history endpoint is per-chatflow only; FTS5 + JSON1 over the local store unlocks audit queries no single API call supports.
novel_features.example: flowiseai-pp-cli predict search 'mortgage rate' --since 7d --used-tool SendGrid --json --select chatId,text
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when auditing what an agent generated, debugging a hallucination, or filtering predictions by which tools or sources they invoked.

novel_features.name: Newsletter audit report
novel_features.description: Per-chatId audit report joining predictions, chat messages, and upsert history; CSV-friendly for compliance archives.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-table join no single API call exposes; pivots time-window slices on what was generated, what RAG it cited, and which tools fired.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this at compliance review time or after a newsletter run to verify every section's provenance.

novel_features.name: RAG corpus drift report
novel_features.description: Show which document stores got new content this week and which chatflows reference each store.
novel_features.rationale: Flowise's `upsert-history` IS the change cursor; the dependency parse comes from cached `flowData` JSON — neither end has a single endpoint that joins them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when investigating why a chatflow's responses changed — drift in the corpus is often the cause.

novel_features.name: Prediction replay
novel_features.description: Re-fire a prior prediction by chatId; optionally diff the new response against the recorded one.
novel_features.rationale: Replay requires the original question and chatflowId resolved from chatId — Flowise doesn't expose that mapping endpoint; we use the local prediction store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to recover from a failed agent run or to compare current chatflow output against a known-good baseline.

novel_features.name: Predict resume (HITL)
novel_features.description: Resume a suspended AgentFlow V2 run by chatId with a structured `humanInput` payload.
novel_features.rationale: Flowise's AgentFlow V2 supports HITL via `humanInput`; resolving the chatflowId from a chatId requires the local cache.
novel_features.example: flowiseai-pp-cli predict resume cm67890 --input '{"type":"proceed","feedback":"Approved by Sam"}'
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a chatflow paused awaiting human approval and an agent needs to drive the resume.

novel_features.name: Chatflow dependency graph
novel_features.description: Show every tool, assistant, variable, and document store referenced by a chatflow; flag missing references.
novel_features.rationale: Parses cached `flowData` JSON locally — the API returns the blob but never extracts the dependency edges.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before deleting or reviewing a chatflow to know what depends on it.

novel_features.name: Stale chatflow finder
novel_features.description: List chatflows not updated in N days, sortable by staleness.
novel_features.rationale: Flowise's list endpoint doesn't filter by updatedDate; local cache makes this a single SQL query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this during housekeeping to find flows that are likely safe to delete.

narrative.headline: Drives a Flowise REST instance from the shell: run chatflows, compose multi-section newsletters, ingest folders into RAG document stores, replay and audit prior predictions.
narrative.value_prop: FlowiseAI gives you a visual builder and a REST runtime for chatflows, assistants, and RAG. This CLI is the single binary that lets an agent (or a human) drive that runtime end-to-end: compose a multi-section newsletter, ingest a folder of source material, replay any prediction by chatId, and audit every response against the source documents it cited.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set FLOWISE_API_KEY to your instance's bearer token and FLOWISE_BASE_URL to your Flowise host (e.g. http://localhost:3000 or https://cloud.flowiseai.com). Use `flowiseai-pp-cli auth set-token <key>` to persist the token in the local config and `flowiseai-pp-cli auth status` to confirm it's wired.

quickstart.comment: Verify auth, host, and local store path are all wired correctly.
See what chatflows are deployed on this instance.

quickstart.command: flowiseai-pp-cli predict abc123 --question "Summarize this week's listings" --json --select text,chatId
quickstart.comment: Send a question to a chatflow and capture the response + chatId.
Fan out across the plan's section chatflows and assemble the draft.
Search every recorded prediction full-text for a topic.

troubleshoots.fix: Confirm FLOWISE_API_KEY is set; some chatflows require a per-flow key - fetch it via `chatflows get-by-api-key <key>` and re-export FLOWISE_API_KEY to that value, or persist with `auth set-token <key>`.
Set FLOWISE_BASE_URL to your Flowise host (default http://localhost:3000). Confirm the host is reachable with `flowiseai-pp-cli ping`.

troubleshoots.symptom: predict returns empty text with sourceDocuments populated
troubleshoots.fix: The chatflow ran retrieval but didn't get to LLM generation. Check overrideConfig for prompt template misconfiguration; pass --explain-config via `chatflow deps --show-overrides`.

troubleshoots.symptom: Newsletter compose section returns 404 on chatflowId
troubleshoots.fix: Run `flowiseai-pp-cli sync` to refresh local cache, then `chatflows list --json --select id,name` and grep client-side to confirm the flow name maps to the right id.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for flowiseai-pp-cli when an agent needs to drive a Flowise instance from a shell — composing newsletters, batch-running predictions across a list, ingesting a folder of RAG source material, replaying a prior prediction for audit, or searching across recorded predictions full-text. It is the only Flowise client that ships compound workflows alongside full REST coverage.

recipes.title: Compose a realtor newsletter from a plan
recipes.command: flowiseai-pp-cli newsletter compose --plan plans/weekly.yml --out drafts/$(date +%F).md --json --select sections.chatId,sections.text
recipes.explanation: Plans declare section name + chatflowId + question + overrideConfig; the CLI fans out and writes the assembled draft plus a JSON manifest of every chatId for downstream audit.

recipes.title: Ingest a folder of MLS exports
recipes.explanation: Walks the folder, uploads each PDF via multipart, then triggers vector indexing; records one upsert-history row per file for the drift report.

recipes.title: Audit last week's newsletter run
recipes.explanation: CSV-formatted join of predictions, chat messages, and upsert history; one row per chatId with the cited document count and tools invoked.

recipes.title: Search recorded predictions for tool usage
recipes.explanation: FTS5 over local predictions store with JSON1 filter on usedTools; ideal for finding every time the agent dispatched an email.

recipes.title: Resume a paused AgentFlow V2 run
recipes.command: flowiseai-pp-cli predict resume cm67890 --input '{"type":"proceed","feedback":"Approved by Sam"}'
recipes.explanation: Looks up the chatflowId from the chatId in local cache and re-fires the prediction with humanInput populated to continue past the HITL checkpoint.

trigger_phrases: ingest documents into a Flowise document store
